processCpu.limitation: CPU is a sampled lower bound: a process born and exited between samples, or CPU after its last sample, cannot be observed. pg_shared includes instance-wide background work.

top25.query: UPDATE "tokens" SET "accessed_time"= $1 ,"remain_quota"=remain_quota +  $2 ,"used_quota"=used_quota -  $3  WHERE id =  $4  AND "tokens"."deleted_at" IS NULL
UPDATE "users" SET "request_count"=request_count +  $1 ,"used_quota"=used_quota +  $2  WHERE id =  $3  AND "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL
UPDATE "users" SET "quota"=quota +  $1  WHERE id =  $2  AND "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL
UPDATE "users" SET "quota"=quota +  $1  WHERE (id =  $2  AND quota <=  $3 ) AND "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL

SELECT (SELECT count(*)::float8 FROM logs WHERE type=$1) AS logs,(SELECT coalesce(sum(quota),$2)::float8 FROM logs WHERE type=$3) AS log_quota,(SELECT coalesce(sum(used_quota),$4)::float8 FROM users WHERE id>=$5) AS users_used_quota,(SELECT coalesce(sum(used_quota),$6)::float8 FROM tokens WHERE id>=$7) AS tokens_used_quota,(SELECT used_quota::float8 FROM channels WHERE id=$8) AS channel_used_quota,(SELECT coalesce(sum(request_count),$9)::float8 FROM users WHERE id>=$10) AS user_requests,(SELECT count(*)::float8 FROM logs WHERE type=$11 AND (quota<>$12 OR prompt_tokens<>$13 OR completion_tokens<>$14)) AS invalid_logs,$15::float8 AS wallet_mismatches
SELECT count(*) FROM "user_subscriptions" WHERE user_id =  $1  AND status =  $2  AND end_time >  $3
SELECT * FROM "tokens" WHERE "key" =  $1  AND "tokens"."deleted_at" IS NULL ORDER BY "tokens"."id" LIMIT  $2

SELECT "users"."id","users"."username","users"."display_name","users"."role","users"."status","users"."email","users"."github_id","users"."discord_id","users"."oidc_id","users"."wechat_id","users"."telegram_id","users"."access_token_created_at","users"."quota","users"."used_quota","users"."request_count","users"."group","users"."aff_code","users"."aff_count","users"."aff_quota","users"."aff_history","users"."inviter_id","users"."deleted_at","users"."linux_do_id","users"."setting","users"."remark","users"."stripe_customer","users"."created_at","users"."last_login_at","users"."auth_version" FROM "users" WHERE id =  $1  AND "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "users"."id" =  $2  ORDER BY "users"."id" LIMIT  $3

SELECT (SELECT MAX(id) FROM "system_tasks" WHERE type =  $1 ), (SELECT MAX(id) FROM "system_tasks" WHERE type =  $2 ), (SELECT MAX(id) FROM "system_tasks" WHERE type =  $3 ), (SELECT MAX(id) FROM "system_tasks" WHERE type =  $4 ), (SELECT MAX(id) FROM "system_tasks" WHERE type =  $5 ), (SELECT MAX(id) FROM "system_tasks" WHERE type =  $6 )

INSERT INTO "system_instances" ("node_name","info","started_at","last_seen_at","created_at","updated_at") VALUES ( $1 , $2 , $3 , $4 , $5 , $6 ) ON CONFLICT ("node_name") DO UPDATE SET "info"="excluded"."info","started_at"="excluded"."started_at","last_seen_at"="excluded"."last_seen_at","updated_at"="excluded"."updated_at"
SELECT * FROM "casbin_rule" ORDER BY id asc

semantics: No external ACK. HTTP completion windows plus final consumption logs, each wallet and token balance, channel counters; quota equivalents divide native quota by 2. This is not a request-ID intersection with external ACK.
